title: Wiki · round 1
intro: Claude Design, 17 Nov. Three directions on the same page (Architecture overview), then the designer's pick drawn on History, Search and a long-title page.

A · Flush: text aligned left with the header, one-line header, sidebar = tree only. Cheapest; at 1720 the right ~600 px are still empty. B · Margin (designer's pick): text column + a 200 px column with outline, latest changes, why it's stale, what links here; title once; Recent → "New to you"; agent notes = folded section. C · Side panel: outline/info/history in the 392 px side panel, only from 1440 up.
B ships in two steps: step 1 needs no new plugin logic and already removes the margins and the double title; step 2 adds the margin column, New to you, history with diff, search snippets.
